rows.name: unit
rows.reason: Local invariants need no service wait; small inputs keep the feedback loop immediate.

rows.name: crate
rows.reason: Allow public encoding and validation while exposing accidental broad fixtures.

rows.name: integration
rows.reason: Allow composition and fault histories without a real-service wait.
rows.scope: one pure or mock integration test

rows.name: conformance
rows.reason: The same predicate needs a small bounded history on every implementation.
rows.scope: one pure or mock shared-contract case

rows.name: property
rows.reason: Bound construction and evaluation by declared sizes; shrinking is included in the campaign below.

rows.name: real-case
rows.reason: Allow actual transactions, RPC and controlled settlement while exposing unnecessary sleeps.

rows.name: pure-suite
rows.reason: A bounded selection of cases should stay interactive; this also covers bounded property generation and shrinking.
rows.scope: one named pure suite or level group

rows.name: mock-suite
rows.reason: Permit model histories and controlled fault schedules without paying service startup cost.

rows.name: postgresql-suite
rows.reason: Reserve time for isolated history, concurrency and restart cases on a provisioned instance.

rows.name: elements-suite
rows.reason: Allow signed blocks, depth, forks and recovery; measure controllable settlement rather than arbitrary sleep.

rows.name: combined-suite
rows.reason: Allow the combined durable and chain recovery path without hiding the cost in fast tests.
rows.scope: one PostgreSQL and Elements end-to-end suite

rows.name: test-command
rows.reason: The measured quiet test step is about nine seconds; keep a small margin and investigate growth.
rows.scope: the per-change pure and mock test command

rows.name: ordinary-check
rows.reason: Make repeated repository checks interactive; retained full-corpus work needs explicit registry review.

rows.name: benchmark
rows.reason: Allow warmup and multiple samples with deterministic work counts; larger campaigns need registry admission.

rows.name: clean-build
rows.reason: A two-minute initial allowance permits dependency compilation; it is a target awaiting a controlled cold measurement, not an observed result.
rows.scope: clean workspace dev or test build

rows.name: incremental-build
rows.reason: An ordinary implementation-file edit should preserve a short feedback loop; profile and dependency fan-out are diagnosed separately.

rows.name: gate
rows.reason: Pinned-node gates of record took 81.2 s and 85.5 s; the latter used about 233 own CPU seconds at about two percent shared CPU pressure. A 120 s warning allowance gives about forty percent margin above the larger observed wall for post-import build work. Warm lane repeats are diagnostics, not the calibration workload.
rows.scope: per-change gate on the imported tree in a fresh checkout, with its own retained node target

rows.name: service-gate
rows.reason: Allow the warm gate and combined real-service cases; the service matrix is separate from the fast local path.

rows.name: reference-map-case
rows.reason: The exact reference declaration retains all Actors, edges, depths and published comparisons; the measured map and corpus cases need a bounded certificate tier.
rows.scope: one published-fixture map or corpus case

rows.name: reference-local-case
rows.reason: Interval Jacobians, preconditioning, replay and mutation controls retain the full reference declaration; the local certificate is the longest measured reference case.

rows.name: reference-wall-case
rows.reason: The end-to-end wall consumer retains both enclosed and rational solve routes and their replay and adjacent Work controls.

rows.name: reference-certificate-suite
rows.reason: Allow the exact reference cases and their refusal controls as a separately measured group while preserving the unchanged fast and gate budgets.

rows.name: reference-receiving-case
rows.reason: The complete published Registration and donor multiplicities, both public histories and both annotation readings must survive compilation, solve and replay. The focused measurement is recorded in the receiving reference-tier amendment; the declared allowance also accounts for gate contention without changing any other case budget.
rows.scope: one full-size published receiving showcase comparison

rows.name: own-burn-case
rows.reason: The lowest sign-certifying precision retains compilation, both solves and replayed forcing; the smaller histories tested change the response sign. This mechanism has its own allowance rather than borrowing the published-reference tier.

rows.name: own-burn-suite
rows.reason: Allow the mechanism case and harness overhead while retaining its separate case warning and the per-commit gate budget.

rows.name: reference-gate
rows.reason: The longest exact local certificate needs about fifty seconds; allow the unchanged certificate cases and runner overhead in a required invocation alongside the per-commit path.

rows.name: calibrated-marker-recognition-case
rows.reason: The recorded property draw count and generated lineage/burn-recognition predicates remain unchanged; reducing draws would remove declared evidence.

rows.name: calibrated-typed-corruptions-case
rows.reason: The recorded property draw count and typed corruption families remain unchanged; reducing draws would remove declared evidence.

rows.name: calibrated-act-directions-case
rows.reason: Opposite signed complete-act comparisons retain both independently replayed solves and the finite forcing bounds at the declared precision.

rows.name: calibrated-act-emission-case
rows.reason: The complete accepted-act pair changes emission and retains independently replayed solves and the full finite-response transport.

rows.name: calibrated-burn-depleted-case
rows.reason: The depleted-source pair retains failed full-rung attempts, passing anchor solves, independent replay and the changed-emission finite shock.

rows.name: calibrated-burn-monotone-case
rows.reason: The sole-contributor pair retains both complete solves, independent replay and the whole-path regime premises.

rows.name: calibrated-burn-sibling-case
rows.reason: The saturated sibling pair retains the declared precision, independent solve replay, finite box shock and largest-direct-forcing feedback majorant.

rows.name: calibrated-burn-switch-case
rows.reason: The burn pair retains both rung searches, the changed accepted rung, independent solve replay and the full finite-response transport.

rows.name: calibrated-certified-splits-case
rows.reason: Matched and unmatched complete histories retain their certified solves, projected residuals, hop-premise checks and counterexample bounds.

rows.name: calibrated-conserved-projection-case
rows.reason: Supported and chartered depth projections retain the nonzero-depth cells, exact cell and Work pins, and refusal controls.

rows.name: calibrated-conserved-residual-case
rows.reason: The frozen fixture retains proposal-grid and iteration-cap comparisons, independent residual replay, exact Work boundaries and mutated-record refusals.

rows.name: calibrated-fence-shapes-case
rows.reason: Frozen-support shapes retain descending evaluated rung searches, independent primitive replay and width, tilt, wall and attachment refusal controls.

rows.name: calibrated-compiled-conservation-case
rows.reason: The named transport mechanisms retain derived ledger export ceilings, declared conservation-width tolerance, passing and failing precision controls and replayed nonlinear transport.

rows.name: calibrated-nonconstant-matched-split-case
rows.reason: Real nonconstant matched transport retains its calibrated disjoint-image precision, compiled hop identities, common positive rung, solves and independent replay.

rows.name: calibrated-positive-rung-split-case
rows.reason: The positive-rung displacement fixture retains the calibrated sign precision, its failing lower control, finite box comparisons and independent solve replay.

rows.name: calibrated-published-isolated-acts-case
rows.reason: The unsorted exact-rate sample family retains every complete before/after history, final-gate checks, independent solve replay and exact loss identity.

rows.name: calibrated-published-retained-act-case
rows.reason: The tagged retained-source fixture retains complete before/after solves, independent replay, the calibrated strict sign and its failing lower-precision control.

rows.name: calibrated-receiving-small-case
rows.reason: The published small receiving history retains pooled and partitioned records, complete public-input annotation equivalence and cross-replayed certificates.

rows.name: calibrated-sibling-outside-paths-case
rows.reason: The coupled negative response retains its calibrated precision and endpoint grid, the failing lower control, independent replay and the separate structural control.

rows.name: calibrated-two-map-box-case
rows.reason: The frozen four-Actor fixture retains its declared box-map precision, both certified maps, independent replay and adjacent Work-limit controls.

rows.name: calibrated-activation-costs-case
rows.reason: Cold composed requests retain independent Work, output-byte and arithmetic-step success/refusal boundaries; reusing a warm result would change the charged request.

rows.name: calibrated-activation-endpoints-case
rows.reason: Wall placements and activation quantities retain direct and monotone evaluations, independent endpoint brackets, generalized joins and powered-source premises.

rows.name: calibrated-activation-oracles-case
rows.reason: Unsorted scalar compositions retain independent value and derivative oracle brackets and cold certified evaluation at the declared policy.

rows.name: calibrated-activation-walls-case
rows.reason: The wall placements retain activation, gain and generalized-kink controls under the complete declared policy.

rows.name: calibrated-enclosed-wall-clamp-case
rows.reason: The wall-coordinate interval retains independently sampled rational clamps, crossing generalized slopes and changed-enclosure replay refusal.

rows.name: calibrated-evaluation-costs-case
rows.reason: Reduction, root/log-exp endpoint and sharing-prefix cases retain every cold Work success/refusal boundary and distinguish preparation from memo hits.

rows.name: calibrated-reference-wall-branches-case
rows.reason: Certified inverse-wall branches retain the floor, door, policy and deadband comparisons and their independently replayed queries.

rows.name: calibrated-reference-wall-controls-case
rows.reason: The inverse-wall controls retain both wrong-sign bracket refusals, indecisive stopping and changed query or attachment replay refusals.

rows.name: calibrated-reference-wall-oracle-case
rows.reason: The tagged gain fixture retains certified bisection, independent endpoint signs and replay at the declared stopping width and precision.

rows.name: calibrated-reference-wall-work-case
rows.reason: The stopping-width family retains cumulative cold Work pins and all adjacent success/refusal boundaries; sharing completed inversions would invalidate those measurements.
